description: This file defines the WebhookRepository class, which manages webhook data including retrieval, filtering, and permission checks within a TypeScript project. It interacts with a database via Prisma and references various related modules and types.

classes.name: WebhookRepository
classes.description: A class that implements webhook data management, including fetching, filtering, and permission validation for webhooks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of WebhookRepository, with a deprecation note suggesting use of dependency injection.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves webhook subscribers based on provided options, including filtering by team, user, event type, and trigger.

methods.name: getSubscribersRaw
methods.description: Executes a raw SQL query to fetch webhook subscribers with various filters, prioritizing platform webhooks, user-specific, event type, parent event type, team, and OAuth client webhooks.

methods.name: getWebhookById
methods.description: Fetches a webhook by its ID, returning detailed webhook information.

methods.name: findByWebhookId
methods.description: Finds a webhook by its ID, throwing if not found, and returns detailed info including version parsing.

methods.name: findByOrgIdAndTrigger
methods.description: Retrieves webhooks associated with a specific organization ID and trigger event.

methods.name: getFilteredWebhooksForUser
methods.description: Fetches webhooks accessible to a user, considering permissions, team memberships, and roles, including platform webhooks for admins.

methods.name: listWebhooks
methods.description: Lists webhooks based on filtering options such as app ID, event type, and triggers, with permission-based team filtering.
